The Katabello

Condominium in Kata
HomeSaleThe Katabello

Project overview

Beachfront condominium steps from Kata Beach with ocean views and pet-friendly living. Construction was reported at about 31% in October 2026.

Prices and availability on request via WhatsApp.

The Katabello: key facts

  • The Katabello is a condominium in Kata, Phuket, developed by Rhom Bho Property PLC (The Title).
  • Units: 1–3 bedrooms, 32–68 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Jun 2027.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿4,240,000.
  • Nearest beach: Kata Beach (1.6 km / 5 minutes, driving).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Chalong Hospital (4.2 km, straight line); Patong Hospital (8.2 km, straight line); Makro (700 m, straight line); Tesco Lotus (3.9 km, straight line).
  • More projects by Rhom Bho Property in our catalogue: Darayana Kamala, The Title Cocoon, The Title Adora Rawai, Biancana, Casa De Monte, Coralina Kamala.
